caption: The drawing depicts a doll with pale blue skin and painted facial features, including red lips and dark eyes. The doll has black hair styled in a central part and worn close to the head. It is dressed in a yellow-green top with puffed sleeves trimmed with pale green at the ends, and it is accented by a diagonal purple sash crossing from its right shoulder to its left waist. The doll wears a long, full dark green skirt with black lace detailing along the bottom and over the surface of the skirt, giving a textured appearance. The doll has black shoes and is depicted against a plain, unembellished beige background.
title: Walking Doll (Mechanical)
